name: newsletter-signup
title: Newsletter sign-up
description: A heading, one sentence, an email TextField and a submit Button, with inline success and error states.

frame.summary: A small form; field and button share a row when there is room.

regions.name: form
regions.purpose: Email field, consent checkbox, submit, result notice.
regions.collapse: flex-wrap: the button drops below the field when the row cannot hold both.

components.name: text
components.for: One sentence and the privacy note.

components.name: text-field
components.for: Email; label visible or labelHidden with a visible placeholder-free prompt.

components.name: checkbox
components.for: Marketing consent where the law requires opt-in.

components.name: button
components.for: Submit; `loading` while the request is in flight.

components.name: notice
components.for: Success or error after submit, live="polite".

components.name: link
components.for: Privacy policy link in the note.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Caller passes a plain anchor in the note slot.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the prompt; everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

onSubmit.summary: Called with the email; resolve to show success, reject to show the error.

consent.summary: Consent checkbox label, when opt-in is required.

behavior.summary: Form state: idle → submitting (Button loading, aria-disabled) → success (Notice replaces nothing; the field stays) or error (TextField status=error with message).

decisions.decision: Confirmation is an inline Notice, not a Toast
decisions.why: A toast disappears; the reader who looked away misses it. The result belongs next to the field they used.

decisions.decision: Validation errors go on the TextField, request errors in the Notice
decisions.why: Field's contract puts status on the field it describes; a network failure is not the field's fault.
A placeholder-as-label vanishes on input; TextField's labelHidden still keeps an accessible name, but a visible one is the default here.

obligations: type="email" and autocomplete="email" on the field.

native.reason: Website-only by decision B3 (gate-1 review, docs/decisions/2026-11-gate-1-review.md): marketing blocks and templates ship on the web only and get no native version. Marketing composition. A native app is reached after install, so there is nothing to persuade or convert; the equivalent content in-app is an onboarding or paywall screen, which is a different block with different obligations.
